boundaries: owner inspection returns exact remaining/used and changes no bytes
active refresh changes only lease state/expiry
expired tombstone retains exact contract and finite spent allowance
exhausted grants refuse refresh while owner inspection reports zero remaining
wrong caller, peer, service or absent relationship refuses refresh
pending immutable send blocks refresh until reconciled/cancelled
lifetime100001 and UInt64 clock wrap refuse refresh
wrong context cannot collect or refresh another context grant
explicit revocation of expired tombstone erases authority permanently
relationship reset and dead-owner cleanup erase authority
slot reuse cannot revive old incarnation-bound handle
malformed used greater than budget refuses inspection and refresh without unsigned underflow
actual op17 dispatch reaches the same shipped refresh helper
policy independently rejects missing ownership/current context/idle state, exhaustion and invalid lifetime
environment: x86-64 Linux: QEMU RV64 system emulation and AArch64 assembly emulator under qemu-aarch64; no physical ARM hardware claim
limitations:
Execute shipped finite grant refresh rules with public broker state fixtures.

The trap supplies exact owner liveness. These checks exercise the real refresh,
expiry, revoke and reset helpers; they establish no network delivery or signing.
